faqs.q: What are common signs of scams?
faqs.a: Scammers may call you asking for a code or password, put you under pressure to act instantly, or send a link asking you to log in directly from an email or text message (SMS).

faqs.q: How can I keep my MyServiceNSW Account secure?
faqs.a: Use a strong password, do not reuse it on other websites, and change your password if prompted when you log in. For extra security, use the Service NSW app or reputable authenticator apps (like Microsoft or Google Authenticator) for multi-factor authentication (MFA).

faqs.q: What should I do if I suspect my account has been compromised?
faqs.a: If you receive an unexpected code or notification, or if you suspect your login information has been compromised, change your MyServiceNSW Account password and contact Service NSW immediately.

faqs.q: How do I stay safe when browsing online?
faqs.a: Stop and think before you click. Carefully examine emails, text messages, and websites for anything suspicious, as messages with unexpected links are often fraudulent. Also, keep your operating system software and apps up to date.
